secret_surface.handoff: Secret Service API or inherited file descriptor/stdin
secret_surface.locked_state: setup required; never fall back to plaintext

surfaces.purpose: time journal and optional visual summaries
surfaces.egress: sampled frames only when summarization is enabled; provider is explicit
surfaces.retention: 14 days or 2 GiB frames; 90 days or 1 GiB journal; 7 daily backups
surfaces.delete: operator-confirmed purge of frames, database, exports, and backups

surfaces.egress: local model by default; model download only on explicit selection
surfaces.retention: session audio is not retained by this plugin; model files persist until clear
surfaces.delete: operator-confirmed model and plugin-managed settings cleanup
surfaces.export: transcription text remains in the user-selected output surface

surfaces.egress: none unless a user action invokes an external consumer
surfaces.retention: 7 days or 1000 entries, subject to host policy
surfaces.delete: host-supported history deletion; preserve unrelated settings

surfaces.purpose: read and send messages through the user-authorized Mac gateway
surfaces.egress: SSH/Tailscale to the configured Mac gateway; no Linux message database
surfaces.retention: attachments opened in a thread may be cached; 7 days by default
surfaces.export: conversation export is not enabled by default

surfaces.delete: provider-side event deletion; local cache cleanup is separate
local cache cleanup; no portfolio data is persisted by this policy

surfaces.purpose: next calendar event title, start time and meeting link in the Island
surfaces.egress: none; reads the local Omarchy calendar file, khal, gcalcli or evolution-data-server read-only (gcalcli talks to Google as it always does)
surfaces.retention: in memory only, next 24 hours, replaced every minute; nothing written to disk
surfaces.delete: nothing to delete; turning the calendar setting off clears the in-memory events

surfaces.purpose: album art display in the Island's Now Playing pill and card
surfaces.egress: one HTTPS image GET to the host in the art URL the playing MPRIS player publishes (for example the player's own image CDN); no credentials, no other data sent; off with the Load album art from the web setting
surfaces.retention: Qt image cache in memory only; nothing is written to disk and the cache is dropped when the shell restarts
surfaces.delete: turn the setting off or restart the shell; nothing persists

surfaces.purpose: current temperature on the Island's Home page
surfaces.egress: runs Omarchy's own omarchy-weather-status, which asks wttr.in for the location Omarchy already uses for its bar weather; only while omarchy.weather is in the bar and Home is open, at most every 30 minutes
surfaces.retention: the last answer in memory only; nothing written to disk
surfaces.delete: turn the weather setting off or remove omarchy.weather from the bar; nothing persists

surfaces.purpose: battery, power profile, fan mode, CPU, memory, network name and Tailscale state on the Home and System pages
surfaces.egress: none; reads sysfs and procfs, powerprofilesctl, nmcli and tailscale status --json locally (only BackendState, Self.Online and the peer count are kept)
surfaces.retention: in memory only, replaced on each read; read once when the shell loads (a startup read, before any card opens), then every 2 s only while the System page is open; Home polls its own status every 3 s only while Home is open
surfaces.delete: nothing to delete; closing the card stops the reads

surfaces.purpose: agent session names, status and window address on the Agents page, to focus a session's terminal
surfaces.egress: none; reads herdr-app ls, Claude Code's ~/.claude/sessions files (pid, name, cwd basename, kind, status only) and hyprctl clients locally
surfaces.retention: in memory only, replaced every 3 s while the Agents page is open
surfaces.delete: nothing to delete; turning the agents setting off stops the reads

surfaces.purpose: unread message counts per chat on the Messages page
surfaces.egress: none; reads Blip's own state file read-only (unread counts, group names and muted chats; never message text)
surfaces.retention: in memory only; chats without a group name are shown by the handle's last four characters
surfaces.delete: nothing to delete; turning the messages setting off stops the watch

surfaces.purpose: Dayflow capture state, frame count and storage on the Dayflow page
surfaces.retention: in memory only, read once per card open
surfaces.delete: nothing to delete; turning the dayflow setting off hides the page

surfaces.purpose: newest Snapdex screenshot names and captions on the Shots page
surfaces.egress: none; reads Snapdex's index.md locally; never runs snapdex itself
surfaces.retention: in memory only, read once per card open; the unseen marker lives in memory and resets with the shell
surfaces.delete: nothing to delete; turning the shots setting off hides the page
